words.label: Where the words sit
words.note: Where the quote sits on the photograph on a wide screen. On a phone it always sits across the foot of the photograph.

centre.label: In the middle
centre.note: The quote in the middle of the photograph. The default.

start.label: On the left
start.note: The quote on the left, the photograph clear on the right. For a photograph whose subject is on the right.

end.label: On the right
end.note: The quote on the right, the photograph clear on the left. For a photograph whose subject is on the left.

scrim.label: Shade
scrim.note: How much of the photograph is darkened. The quote always sits on a dark shade that keeps it readable, whichever you pick.

fade.label: Behind the words
fade.note: A soft shade behind the quote only; the rest of the photograph shows as it is. The default.

full.label: The whole photograph
full.note: The whole photograph is evenly darkened and the quote sits in the mood of it. For a busy or bright photograph.

motion.label: Movement
motion.note: Whether this section moves as the visitor reaches it. Nothing moves for a visitor who has asked their device for less motion, whichever you pick.

default.label: Still
default.note: Nothing moves. The section is simply there when the visitor reaches it, which is the default.

moving.label: Moves
moving.note: The photograph drifts slowly into place over five seconds as the quote comes into view, once, then holds still. It needs the platform's behaviour library; where that is not served the section is simply still.
